newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador will miss '97 budget target-Davalos.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador will miss '97 budget target-Davalos.

text.p: Ecuador will not be able to meet its target of a budget deficit of 2.7 percent of gross domestic product in 1997, said Finance Minister Carlos Davalos on Tuesday.

"There are certain factors which could cause problems if they occur or persist. Together they may require additional income which we estimate will increase the budget deficit to 3.3 percent of gross domestic product," Davalos told reporters.
He said that extra spending will result from bad weather and salary increases for workers, while lower oil prices will cut income.
